text: MY family was a house Christians and Some were Muslims. Most of them were fallen out of the love of Christ and showed bad examples of the love of Jesus Christ. But I remember they came back to repent and praise The Lord and Grace from God for all of their sins . And some remains hypocrites or left the church and served themselves or another God full of hate and no love. I didn't let that dictate my life or my kids lives I live God . I am a vessel for good not evil and service for all God's loyal people and to help bring the lost back to God who loved them very much and forgave them in advance . 😊 I don't think suicidal thoughts anymore . I don't give up and I don't allow the devil or the mind games to play with me and think badly about myself , or others and I focus on the positive things and accept when things don't go as planned bcuz it was God's plan that overrides what we think is best for us but is aligned for the purpose. Because God warned me and I saw what it did to so many good people . I am trying so hard Lord to be a good example even though I fall short at times . I am grateful that God give me another chance to fix it and to remain honest and consistent with the journey and that mirror I see on the wall now I dont only see myself I see others ane the world in it too . I see life outside of myself and everything I do is for people not just myself or my kids and loved ones. I choose to love all . Every. Single. One. Of . You. ... Because the devil didn't destroy me or anything that was destined for me and others attached to me. The devil is a liar. The Lord is the truth . Let us all repent again if we have to and allow God to remain in our hearts and strengthen our faith . TRUST THE LORD . TRUST THE LORD.... I TRUST YOU GOD . FOREVER AND ALWAYS . LOVE, YOUR FAITHFUL SERVANT, YOUR DAUGHTER, YOUR EVERYTHING  THAT YOU CREATED . I HOPE HOOE TO MAKE YOU PROUD . -TRELLONY
